31 weeks = 31 × 7 = 217 days.  
Add 2 days → total 219 days.  
03-05-1103 + 219 days:  
1103 is not a leap year (divisible by 4 but not 400, so not leap in Gregorian proleptic).  
From March 5:  
March: 31–5 = 26 days remaining → 219–26 = 193 left.  
April: 30 → 193–30 = 163.  
May: 31 → 163–31 = 132.  
June: 30 → 132–30 = 102.  
July: 31 → 102–31 = 71.  
August: 31 → 71–31 = 40.  
September: 30 → 40–30 = 10.  
October: add 10 days → October 10, 1103.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1103-10-10
